description: Round 4 held-out clause set for the final shipped reader (rules + Jev). Written by the developer in the style of real client briefs (Vietnamese with and without diacritics, English; clinic, logistics, school, HR, retail, finance) and labelled on 2026-10-17 BEFORE any reader (rules or Jev) was run on them. Never used to tune rules, prompts or thresholds before this run. Size limited to 16 clauses by the remaining Jev credits (2 clauses per credit).
